owner_report.source: Direct owner statement in project chat
owner_report.statement: I already have a working formwork.
owner_report.scope: Accept the existing form as a working fallback. No measured placement error, repeatability, completed repair or water test is supplied.

objective: A further print must offer a meaningful prospect of more precise repair-collar placement. The owner accepts a failed over-tight trial and does not need another conservative fit solution.

probability.latest_owner_language: a nice coin toss of getting my formwork even more dialed in
probability.interpretation: Value and risk preference, not a numerical probability supported by evidence. Do not shrink holes merely to cause an arbitrary failure rate.

decision.recommendation: Retain RF05 as an optional precision experiment: upper round 6.5 mm, lower 9 x 6.5 mm slot along the locator line. Keep the working form as fallback. Do not shrink further or change the working collar dimensions on this evidence.
decision.diagonal_reason: Upper round opening locates XY; lower radial slot accommodates spacing variation while limiting rotation. Not required by bolt tilt. A horizontal lower slot also clears the modeled shaft but allows slightly more rotational freedom in this model.
decision.benefit: Substantially less possible movement before bracing; more repeatable locating is plausible. Collar profile, depth, reliefs and surface geometry match the working design.
decision.critical_limit: Less play does not establish correct absolute placement. If the working form is already aligned correctly and firmly braced, RF05 may offer no repair-accuracy benefit. A repeatable but incorrect scan-derived position is not an improvement.
decision.success_criterion: Unforced seating/removal, visibly less movement than the working form, and correct repair-opening alignment with the actual factory inner plate/control assembly. Use existing parts and an ordinary fit comparison, not a new survey. Independent support remains necessary during repair.

executed_model_comparison.scope: Original-scan fitted bare shaft lines, 5 mm evaluation diameter, seated 3 mm tab. Nuts excluded. No scan re-registration.
executed_model_comparison.method: SLSQP separately minimized/maximized form X, Y and angle with three starting poses. At Z=-3 and 0, transform shaft centers into the moved form frame, constrain distance to the slot center segment <= hole radius - 2.5*sqrt(1+shaft_slope_squared). Round hole has zero-length segment. Endpoints suffice for a segment contained in a convex eroded capsule. Bounds +/-10 mm, +/-5 degrees were not reached. Successful solutions had constraint residuals >= -1e-6 mm. Numerically estimated model ranges, not certified global bounds.
limits: Total ranges between opposite modeled extremes, not plus/minus placement accuracy. Independent extrema are not simultaneously reachable.
No friction, bracing, print distortion, shaft flex, scan error or preload. Actual play of the working print is not measured.
Existing fixed-pose RF05 upper-hole minimum gap about 0.054 mm is a geometric residual, not an uncertainty allowance. The candidate already accepts substantial binding risk.
No new physical fit test or repair accuracy measurement was executed.
